review.recipe: Master passed: clear pale-gold jaggery gin Collins over ordinary wet ice; fine bubbles and one orange peel inside, no foam.
review.personality: Handled document-folder leather and released clasp now on inner right edge of portrait-safe cluster. Rumpled used handkerchief remains partly visible at inner edge in phone, fuller in wide; not literal campaign costume.
review.world: Worn walnut old room, practical warm right lamp, near-black neutral shadows; one whole blank cream thread-tied tag glass-width and frontal.
